title: Freestanding Paper Towel Holder, 18-Inch Tall, Solid Brass Weighted Base (Traditional Style) | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your countertop with a freestanding paper towel holder crafted from solid brass, featuring an 18-Inch height and a weighted base designed to help prevent tipping.

  • Freestanding convenience: No wall mounting required—easy to place where you need it (freestanding).
  • Traditional styling: A refined look that coordinates with traditional bathroom hardware, classic bath accessories, and heritage bathroom fixtures-inspired décor.
  • Stable on the counter: Solid brass weighted base helps reduce tipping.
  • Surface protection: Felt pad helps prevent scratches on countertops and other surfaces.
  • Finish options: Available in a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes, including statement colors.

Specs
Material: Brass
Style: Traditional
Mounting type: Freestanding
Dimensions: 5.5-Inch L x 5.5-Inch W x 18-Inch H
Weight: 4.8 lb
Assembly required: No
Included: Paper towel holder
Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

_previous.description: Complete your kitchen décor with this finely crafted counter top paper towel holder. Keep your counter top clutter free while adding the finishing touch to your space. Made of solid brass and provided with a lifetime finish to insure products will never rust.
